newsitem.title: LITHUANIA: RAILWAY CARGO UP, PASSENGERS DOWN.
newsitem.headline: RAILWAY CARGO UP, PASSENGERS DOWN.

text.p: Lithuania's national railway company said on Tuesday that it transported 7.133 million tonnes of cargo in the first three months of this year compared to 5.829 million tonnes in the corresponding period last year.
The state-run company also said in a statement that it carried 2.834 million passengers in the first quarter of 1997, down from 3.321 million in the first three months of 1996.
The company said that the lion's share of its increased volume of cargo came from goods transported across Lithuania's territory.
In the first three months of 1997 the company moved 4.191 million tonnes of cargo across Lithuania compared to 2.907 million tonnes last year.
The amount of imported cargo handled by the company in the first quarter rose to 1.127 million tonnes from 1.075 million tonnes in the same period last year.
Exports transported by Lithuanian Railways fell to 1.079 million tonnes from 1.123 million tonnes in the first quarter of 1996.
